notes: 200 new videos from 50 distinct YouTube channel IDs; no previously published video is reused. Duration 15–180 seconds. Public metadata confirms a real Turkish caption track (including ASR), embed permission and availability in Turkey at inspection time. No automatic translation is counted as Turkish captions. These checks do not guarantee future availability, caption accuracy or playback on every device. Videos are embedded from the publisher; no video, audio or thumbnail file is stored in the repository. Editorial captions distinguish interpretation, theory, archive material and entertainment.
